blocks.content: The Universe is the infinite expanse of space containing all matter and energy — galaxies, stars, planets, satellites, nebulae, black holes, dark matter, and cosmic radiation.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Big Bang Theory is the primary scientific explanation for the origin and early evolution of the universe.
Red Shift observation provides key empirical evidence showing that galaxies are moving away from each other, indicating an expanding universe.
Understanding the origin, meaning, and expansion of the universe forms a fundamental part of general science syllabus for competitive exams.

blocks.content: Proposed by Georges Lemaître and supported by Edwin Hubble’s observation that galaxies are moving away from each other (Red Shift phenomenon).
• Universe began as an extremely hot and dense point called a singularity.
• A massive explosion caused expansion of space.

items: The concept and features of the Big Bang Theory appear very frequently in objective-type general studies papers.
Red Shift and its relation to galactic distance and cosmic expansion is an exam favorite question topic.

blocks.content: Red shift refers to the increase in wavelength of light from galaxies moving away from us. It is the strongest evidence that the universe is expanding.
